name: What are the main methods for slab leak repair?

mainEntity.name: What are the main methods for slab leak repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary methods for slab leak repair include direct access, re-routing, and pipe lining. Direct access involves breaking through the slab to repair or replace the damaged section of pipe. Re-routing bypasses the damaged pipe by installing a new line through walls or the attic. Pipe lining inserts a new epoxy liner into the existing pipe. The choice of method depends on factors such as the leak's location, the extent of damage, pipe material, and accessibility, which a plumbing professional will assess to determine the most effective approach for your Henderson home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Slab leak repair methods are direct access (breaking the slab), re-routing (new pipe line), and pipe lining.
